transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to convene the batch-disposition huddle for Batch H-418. As you know, a cure-temperature alarm appeared during the Tuesday night run on Press 8, and the electronic production record shows the programmed temperature within spec. I need to get the laboratory report and a pallet-level traceability check before I can make my final disposition decision on those 1,000 molded housings staged on pallets P1 through P4. Can someone walk me through what we have so far?

transcript.text: Elena, here are my laboratory findings from the differential-scanning-calorimetry review of the retained samples. The DSC analysis confirmed that exactly 240 housings from Batch H-418 are undercured as a result of the cure-temperature alarm. These 240 undercured housings require a 4-hour thermal rework, and after rework, all 240 of those reworked housings must undergo a hardness test before they can be released. The remaining 760 housings showed acceptable cure levels. I still need to complete the final upload of this report to the quality system, but those are the findings.
